title: Y Combinator grad and AI insurance brokerage Harper raises $47M (TechCrunch)
notes: TechCrunch (Dominic-Madori Davis), 2026-02-25. Harper (AI-native commercial insurance brokerage) raised $46.8M combined Seed+Series A; Series A led by Emergence Capital; investors YC, Lobster Capital, Peak XV. CEO/co-founder Dakotah Rice (prev Poolit). YC W25; 5,000+ customers; 160+ carriers.
